API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIAPI AuthenticationPost Authenticated Session Info
Post Authenticated Session Info
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/authenticatedSession

Creates an authenticated session. The response returns a cookie in the header called JSESSIONID that must be used in subsequent requests.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

User credential.

apiKey
string

The obfuscated form of the API key

username
string

Username of admin user that is provisioned

password
string

Password of the admin user

timestamp
string

Long value that represent the the current time in milliseconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC. This timestamp value must be reflecting the real current time.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation. The response contains authType information only when authentication has completed successfully, regardless of the response code given.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
authType
string

Login type

Possible values: [ADMIN_LOGIN, SUPPORT_ACCESS_PARTIAL, SUPPORT_ACCESS_FULL, PARTNER_ACCESS, INTEGRATION_PARTNER_ACCESS, DEFAULT_LOGIN, ADMIN_SAML_SSO_LOGIN, SUPPORT_ACCESS_READ_ONLY, MOBILE_APP_TOKEN]

obfuscateApiKey
boolean

Whether API key was obfuscated or not

Default value: false
passwordExpiryTime
int64

Password Expiry Time

passwordExpiryDays
int32

Password Expiry Days
